scope: P1 sub-tasks T10 (E4, cross-environment stability), T11 (36-subject grouped CV) and T14 (E8-a, E8-b). No P2 sub-task (72, 73). No test split. T_k, O_k, L_k and R_k are not changed.

e4.not_in_the_protocol: pool = per-family top 5 (no redundancy filter); Lasso path rule (first penalty with at least q non-zero, largest |coefficient|); the candidate library (tau*, k*) is fixed on all training subjects
e4.conditional_stability_note: tau* and k* of the candidate library are fixed on all training subjects of the protocol and are not re-estimated inside a half sample, so E4 measures the stability of the selection conditional on the candidate library; it is not the stability of the complete candidate-construction process (kernel choice included). The 36-subject CV re-estimates tau* in every fold.

cv_36.scheme: sklearn GroupKFold(n_splits=6, shuffle=False); no random seed in the assignment
cv_36.alternative_scheme: the seed-42 permutation of the initial method check (superseded 2026-10-18; its record is kept in discovery_checks/cv_check_fold0_record.json and is not a formal membership)
cv_36.inner: 3-fold subject-grouped CV inside the training subjects, baseline refitted per inner split (llm_fitness.group_splits), forward selection k_max 10, paired 1-SE, ridge grid logspace(-3, 3, 13)

e8.anchor_rule: prefix_causal, n_anchors 9 for the 24-lag rebuild (last reading held)
e8.reliable_window: level confirmed or grid and all anchors the oldest lag needs present
e8.validation_comparison: original base vs anchor-causal base on the same anchor-reliable validation windows, subject-equal RMSE, 20-window rule
e8.e8b: residual ridge on the anchor-causal residuals with the selected M, T_k, O_k; alpha re-selected on validation; factors not reselected
e8.reporting: Reported separately: (i) the loss of rebuilding the base from native readings (E8-a: original base against anchor-causal base on the same reliable validation windows, with the matched control); (ii) the marginal effect of the added M, T, O blocks on each base (block against the base of the same lags); (iii) for completeness the total change (original base + block against anchor-causal base + block). No rule or parameter is changed on the basis of the smoke runs.

cv_36_disclosure: The 36 subjects include the 9 Protocol-B validation subjects whose validation windows took part in the earlier model development (T_7, alpha, k, many diagnostics). The CV re-runs the whole pipeline without the outer subjects in every fold, but its design was fixed with these subjects in view: it is supplementary robustness evidence, not a completely independent external confirmation.
